_about: Deliberate bugs in hid_fi/thermal.h. tests/unit/test_thermal.py::test_every_planted_bug_is_caught applies each and requires the bench's answers to change. A mutation that survives means the tests have a blind spot. Each 'find' must match the current source exactly once.

mutations.name: readings cut to tenths instead of rounded
the peak follows the latest reading
mutations.find: if (l.peakDeci == NONE || d > l.peakDeci) l.peakDeci = d;

mutations.name: a failed minute logs the last value
mutations.find: const int16_t first = l.accN ? (int16_t)lroundf((float)l.accSum / l.accN) : NONE;
mutations.replace: const int16_t first = l.accN ? (int16_t)lroundf((float)l.accSum / l.accN) : l.nowDeci;

mutations.name: a dead sensor keeps showing its last reading
impossible values accepted
mutations.find: inline bool plausible(float c) { return !isnan(c) && c >= MIN_C && c <= MAX_C; }
mutations.replace: inline bool plausible(float c) { return true; }

mutations.name: the driver's failure ignored
the log count runs past the ring
the log read from slot 0, not the oldest
mutations.find: const uint16_t start = (uint16_t)((l.head + LOG_LEN - l.count) % LOG_LEN);

mutations.name: a minute's readings carried into the next
a long stall keeps the minute before it
mutations.find: for (uint32_t i = n - keep; i < n; i++)

mutations.name: only one minute closed per reading
a good read does not end a run of failures
never moves to the high band
mutations.find: if (cur == BAND_LOW && deci >= BAND_UP_DECI) return BAND_HIGH;

mutations.name: never comes back down
mutations.find: if (cur == BAND_HIGH && deci <= BAND_DOWN_DECI) return BAND_LOW;

mutations.name: a missing reading drops to the low band
the latency budget never strikes
the budget itself counts as slow
a fast read does not clear the strikes
a tripped guard never switches off
the worst tick not kept
failures not counted
